definitions.gloss: Seven Lucky Gods; Seven Gods of Fortune
definitions.explanation: a group of seven deities from various traditions believed to bring good luck and fortune in Japanese mythology

examples.japanese: {七福神|しちふくじん}{巡|めぐ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go on a Seven Lucky Gods pilgrimage.
Pictures of the Seven Lucky Gods are considered good luck.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{七福神|しちふくじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祀|まつ}る⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参拝|さんぱい}した→参拝する：15627_sanpaisuru⟧。
examples.english: I visited shrines enshrining the Seven Lucky Gods on New Year's.

notes:
THE SEVEN GODS:
1. {恵比寿|えびす} (Ebisu) - god of fishers and merchants
2. {大黒天|だいこくてん} (Daikokuten) - god of wealth and commerce
3. {毘沙門天|びしゃもんてん} (Bishamonten) - god of warriors
4. {弁財天|べんざいてん} (Benzaiten) - goddess of arts and knowledge
5. {福禄寿|ふくろくじゅ} (Fukurokuju) - god of longevity
6. {寿老人|じゅろうじん} (Jurōjin) - god of longevity
7. {布袋|ほてい} (Hotei) - god of happiness

CULTURAL NOTE:
{七福神|しちふくじん}{巡|めぐ}り is a popular New Year's tradition where people visit temples and shrines dedicated to each of the seven gods.

SYMBOLISM:
- {宝船|たからぶね} - treasure ship, often depicted carrying all seven gods
- ⟦{縁起物|えんぎもの}→縁起物：15731_engimono⟧ - good luck charm
